subject: gk
question: The 11th Fundamental Duty provides opportunities for education for the ______ age group of children.
solution:
The correct answer is __**6-14 years**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 11th Fundamental Duty was added by the 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002.
 
• It states that it is the duty of every parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to their child or ward between the **ages of 6 and 14 years**.
 
• This amendment also led to the insertion of Article 21A, making education a fundamental right for children in this age group.
 
• It emphasizes the importance of education in the development and empowerment of children, ensuring their right to free and compulsory education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Constitution (Eighty-Sixth Amendment) Act, 2002, was enacted to provide free and compulsory education to all children of the age of six to fourteen years as a fundamental right.
 
• Article 51A (k) was added to the Constitution under Part IV-A (Fundamental Duties), which specifies this duty of parents and guardians.
 
• Education is a critical factor in the growth and development of an individual and the nation.
 
• The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009, commonly known as the RTE Act, was enacted to implement this constitutional provision.
